latestVersion.changelog:
Skill Finder v1.0.1 introduces improved usability and installation verification.

- Added step to verify skill installation after running install command.
- Search results now display download count and stars.
- Clearly indicate whether each skill is already installed.
- Enhanced output format for better clarity in Chinese.
- Minor workflow and usage documentation improvements.
